en.commandcodeHelp: Parallel requests to /alpha/billing/credits and /alpha/billing/subscriptions (default API base https://api.commandcode.ai). Monthly totals use a known-plan snapshot; unknown plans show remaining credits only. Monthly-pool depletion does not imply purchased/free credits are unusable. Shows the selected account's quota (the default/top-level key account when none is selected), which may differ from the serving account; a custom apiBase in the provider plugin is not followed. Account switching lives in the “Command Code accounts” block below — the same switch as the pill popover; the quota tool reports every account plus which one is active.
en.commandcodeManaged: Credentials are managed by the Command Code provider plugin (Settings → Command Code); this page is read-only and stores nothing. Usage is fetched directly by this plugin from its billing endpoint, using the same credential sources (credential service COMMANDCODE_API_KEY → launch environment → ~/.commandcode/auth.json).
en.errAuth: Sign-in or credentials were rejected; check or re-enter them
en.errConfig: The local subscription settings could not be read or saved
en.errConfigChanged: Settings changed during the read; refresh
en.errCredentials: Credentials could not be resolved; check the credential source
en.errHttp: The service is temporarily unavailable; retry shortly
en.errIdentityTimeout: Credential resolution timed out; retry shortly
en.errRateLimit: Rate limited; backing off as the server asked, retry shortly
en.errResponse: The usage response could not be parsed (the upstream API may have changed)
en.errRevisionConflict: Settings were changed in another window; reload before saving
en.errTimeout: The query timed out; retry shortly or query fewer providers
en.errUnknownProvider: The running Host is older and does not know this provider; restart DSH to take effect
en.grokHelp: The X Subscription and legacy SuperGrok share this entry: /v1/billing?format=credits plus /v1/settings. If the credits format returns 500 on a migrated account, weekly percent falls back to grok.com gRPC-web. The new weekly pool is shared by eligible first-party Grok, Grok Bot and Cursor usage for the seat, not an additional Cursor quota. The plan comes from subscription_tier_display; prepaidBalance is shown in USD. A missing proxy percentage yields partial data, never fabricated 0% or prepaid spending as included usage. Team seats have individual weekly pools and a shared prepaid balance; this entry reads only the signed-in identity, not a workspace aggregate. OAuth sign-in is required; XAI_API_KEY is not a substitute.
en.grokManaged: Credentials are the OAuth login file shared by dsh-grok-kit / Grok CLI (~/.grok/auth.json); this page stores nothing and only reads the file. When the access token expires, this plugin renews it through dsh-grok-kit's (≥0.2.0) official sign-in chain — same file, same write lock, so the shared login cannot be invalidated by this renewal; it only asks for a manual re-login when dsh-grok-kit is absent or renewal fails. Usage is fetched first from the Grok CLI billing proxy (cli-chat-proxy.grok.com); if that credits format fails, the same credential is used against grok.com GetGrokCreditsConfig.
en.hint: Shows subscription usage for the current model provider. Keys inherit from the credential service or environment, or can be set manually. MiMo uses the official platform Cookie. Only active providers refresh every minute. Fetch success does not mean quota remains.
en.keyPlaceholder: Leave empty to keep; type to override
en.mimoCookie: Sensitive Cookie (replace only; never filled back)
en.mimoCookieHint: Sign in on the official platform and import JSON, name=value lines or a TAB table. Cookie is validated before saving and is never filled back. Requires api-platform_serviceToken and userId.
en.mimoCookieTtl: The official session Cookie lasts 24 hours; the countdown starts at sign-in or import. The usage pill warns before it runs out.
en.mimoCookieUntracked: Login time not recorded (Cookie saved by an older version); sign in again to start the countdown
en.pillNeedCommandcode: Setup required — sign in under Settings → Command Code, run cmd login, or export COMMANDCODE_API_KEY and retry.
en.pillNeedCookie: Login required — paste a cookie in Settings → Subscription usage.
en.pillNeedDeepseekAccount: Sign in under DSH Settings → Account & balance; this entry does not use an API key.
en.pillNeedGrok: Login required — sign in under Settings → Grok Kit (xAI OAuth) or run grok login (shared login file ~/.grok/auth.json).
en.pillNeedKey: No API key — open Settings → Subscription usage to fill one in, or export the same-named env variable and restart.
en.planSnapshotLimit: Monthly total uses a plan snapshot, excluding purchased/free credits; unknown plans have no estimated cap
en.statusIncludedAdvice: Base quota used up; subscription usage still advised
en.statusPaygoSub: Purchased balance or billing advice permits paid usage; the server and actual balance remain authoritative
en.statusPoolAvailable: Rotation pool still has usable accounts
